ios.desc:
Meet HoneyDo, your voice-activated grocery list assistant that understands the art of communication in a marriage. Imagine never having to scribble down or type out a grocery list again. With HoneyDo, simply speak your list into existence, and let our advanced AI handle the rest. It's like having your partner's thoughtful reminders in your pocket, without the fear of forgetting the smallest detail.

We know the drill—your spouse rattles off a list of items, and by the time you reach the store, you've forgotten half of them. HoneyDo's voice recognition technology is your memory's best friend. Speak naturally, as if you were having a conversation, and watch as your words transform into a neatly organized list. Quantity, brand preferences, and even specific notes like "the one near the entrance" are all captured effortlessly.

PIC TO PICK
But HoneyDo isn't just a one-trick pony. Our "Pic to Pick" feature revolutionizes how you shop. Snap a photo of a meal or pantry, and our AI will identify and list the ingredients for you. It's like magic, turning inspiration into a tangible shopping list.

SHARED LISTS & SYNCING
With shared lists, sync your grocery needs with your partner or roommate via iCloud. Collaborate in real-time, ensuring everyone's needs are met. And if you ever need to revisit what was said, the original voice memos are just a tap away.

EDIT WITH EASE
Need to make changes? Just speak up! Add items, remove them, or update details with natural language. HoneyDo adapts to your needs, ensuring your list is always up-to-date and accurate.

MULTILINGUAL MASTERY
Whether you're an English speaker, a Spanish enthusiast, or a Mandarin master, HoneyDo is your multilingual shopping companion. Speak in any language, and let HoneyDo do the rest.

A FAMILY AFFAIR
HoneyDo knows that shopping is a family affair. That's why our app subscription can be shared with up to 5 family members, making sure everyone is on the same page.

---

Download HoneyDo today and transform your grocery shopping experience. Speak, snap, and shop with the confidence that nothing will be left behind. Your sweetheart will be amazed, and your fridge will be stocked. Tap "GET" now and make your grocery list a task of the past.

---

HoneyDo is free to download and empowers you with the ability to record up to 5 voice memos and capture 3 "Pic to Pick" images. For those who seek the ultimate convenience, upgrade to HoneyDo PRO. The auto-renewing subscription unlocks unlimited voice recording

show_hn.title: Show HN: iOS Grocery List App Powered by Whisper and GPT4

quotes.text:
Hey,

I'm an iOS engineer who took on the seemingly mad task of creating a new grocery app in this day and age. Yes, there are plenty out there, but I promise there's a method to my madness.

It's born out of a personal need – my wife would rattle off a list of things to buy, and I'd struggle to remember them all. She's not a fan of typing into apps or shared notes, and honestly, neither am I when it's about speed. The epiphany was that all existing grocery apps have an input problem. They're not catering to the way real people communicate about errands. So, I built HoneyDo to solve my own problem, which I suspect might be yours too.

Here's how it works: You or your partner can tell HoneyDo what to buy in a natural, conversational manner. "We need eggs, milk, and don't forget the chocolate cake that's near the entrance." Whisper and GPT4 processes this and voila, a neatly organized list appears on both your phones (synced via iCloud).

Technically speaking, I've crafted a full-stack solution with Swift (it's a native iOS app), and a Node.js-powered backend on AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, and OpenAI's API.

I'd love to get feedback. Whether it's about the UI/UX, the technical stack, or how the app performs in real-life scenarios, I'm all ears. I'm here to learn and improve, so please, be brutally honest.
